papers.title: Can Discrete Tokens Serve as Semantically Lossless Representations of Visual Signals?
papers.abstract: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ

ai_summary.problem: 论文挑战“量化误差必然导致语义损失、连续视觉表示是内在上限”的假设，研究离散视觉 token 能否作为语义无损的视觉表示，并缩小其与连续表示在多模态理解上的差距。
ai_summary.method: 作者发现量化误差并非可靠指标，离散索引的有效比特预算才是下游性能关键；为此提出 Factorized Vector Quantization（FVQ），用对称并行码本量化视觉特征的互补固定维度视图，以缓解码本饱和，并在工业级多模态数据上训练。
ai_summary.result: FVQ 在更大比特预算下持续提升，最终在多模态理解上匹配连续视觉表示；在九项指标平均上分别超过 UniAR 和 Emu3-Chat 22.8% 与 59.2%，并成为首个在包括细粒度 OCR 任务上可与 Qwen3-VL 等强连续表示模型竞争的离散表示模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 论文重新审视量化误差与语义保真度的关系，提出以有效比特预算为核心视角，并用 FVQ 缓解码本饱和，使离散视觉 token 首次在多项理解任务上接近甚至匹配连续表示。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作支持离散视觉表示作为大规模原生多模态基础模型接口的潜力，对世界模型、多模态大模型和统一 token 建模具有启发意义。

papers.title: Perceiving and Predicting Dynamic Sports: Spatiotemporal Intelligence in Vision Models for Egocentric Tennis Video
papers.abstract: Agile robots require spatiotemporal intelligence to interpret scenes, reason about interactions, and anticipate future events. Yet it remains unclear how well foundation vision models support these capabilities, particularly from a moving egocentric camera, which is a natural view for robots. To investigate this, we collect an annotated tennis dataset and train a suite of vision models on spatiotemporal tasks. Our dataset contains egocentric video synchronized with five allocentric videos, estimated global positions, labeled contact times, and annotated stroke types. We then evaluate seven prediction tasks from egocentric images: 2D ego player and 3D ball localization, future player and ball trajectories, forehand or backhand stroke anticipation, time to the next ego player ball contact, and 3D ball position at that contact. We compare image encoders, video encoders, and vision-language models with jointly trained prediction heads. The best performing models achieve mean current-frame localization errors of 0.14 m for the ego player and 0.54 m for the ball, future forecasting errors of 0.34 m for the ego player and 0.91 m for the ball over 1.1 s, and a mean contact-time prediction error of 0.14 s. Auxiliary depth information substantially improves 3D ball localization, suggesting that inferring metric depth remains a challenge. Longer image histories do not improve ball forecasting, indicating that representations exploit scene context rather than rely solely on inter-frame motion. Finally, we propose a conditional diffusion model to generate whole-body kinematic tennis motion from vision encoder predictions on egocentric video at real-time rates, adapting movements as predictions are refined. These results move towards a deeper understanding of how foundation vision models can support real-time dynamic robots using egocentric video.

ai_summary.problem: 论文研究基础视觉模型能否从移动第一人称视角的视频中支持实时时空感知、交互推理与未来事件预测，并以网球视频作为具身智能测试场景。
ai_summary.method: 构建带标注的第一人称网球数据集（同步多视角、全局位置、触球时间与击球类型），在七项时空预测任务上系统评测图像编码器、视频编码器和视觉语言模型；并提出条件扩散模型，根据视觉编码预测实时生成全身网球运动学动作。
ai_summary.result: 最佳模型实现第一人称球员/球当前定位误差0.14 m/0.54 m、1.1秒未来预测误差0.34 m/0.91 m、触球时间误差0.14 s；辅助深度显著提升3D球定位，更长图像历史未提升球轨迹预测。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了面向第一人称动态体育的多任务时空基准，并联合评测基础视觉模型与实时条件扩散动作生成。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型、具身智能和实时机器人感知提供了关于第一人称视频中时空推理能力与局限的实证基准。

papers.title: Understanding the limits of latent world models
papers.abstract: World models are widely proposed as core components for enabling agents to reason over long temporal and spatial horizons. Yet current evaluations often emphasize task performance while providing limited insight into whether learned world models acquire predictive latent dynamics that reflect the underlying structure of the environment. Here we introduce the concept of faithful latent world models as an equivariance condition between the environment's transition map and the learned latent dynamics. We propose latent rollout consistency (LRC) as a metric to evaluate action-conditioned latent prediction. Strikingly, we find that across the studied state of the art latent world models, none solves the task by actually faithfully modeling the dynamics of the environment.

ai_summary.problem: 当前潜空间世界模型多以任务表现评估，尚不清楚其学到的预测性潜动态是否真实反映环境结构；论文要回答潜世界模型是否“忠实”建模环境动力学。
ai_summary.method: 作者将“忠实的潜世界模型”形式化为环境转移映射与学习到的潜动态之间的等变性条件，并提出潜 rollout 一致性（LRC）指标来评估动作条件下的潜预测。
ai_summary.result: 在所研究的最新潜世界模型中，没有一个模型是通过真正忠实地建模环境动力学来完成任务的。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出以等变性定义潜世界模型的忠实性，并引入 LRC 指标来诊断潜动态是否与环境转移结构一致。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作揭示当前世界模型评估与建模能力的根本差距，对世界模型、Agent 和基于模型的规划研究具有重要警示意义。

papers.title: As the Story Unfolds: Watching a Film and Identifying Characters as a Human Does
papers.abstract: Films introduce characters incrementally as they progress. We study the problem of identifying principal characters and assigning their names directly from the movie itself, without using external cast lists, actor photographs, or pre-built character banks. We introduce the character naming task: given a name mentioned in dialogue and the associated video context, the model must determine which visible character bears that name. This task is challenging because name resolution often depends on cinematic cues such as shot-reverse-shot structure, self-introduction, direct address, third-party reference, gaze, and temporal continuity. We provide a dataset and annotations for evaluating character naming and first character appearances, develop a video-and-dialogue model for the task, and compare it with proprietary multimodal large language models. We further introduce a progressive framework for building a character bank as the film unfolds. Together, these contributions support online, human-like movie understanding in which character identities are inferred from the film itself.

ai_summary.problem: 论文研究如何仅凭电影本身（对话与视频）识别主要角色并将姓名对应到可见人物，不依赖外部演员表、演员照片或预建角色库。
ai_summary.method: 提出“角色命名”任务，并构建包含角色命名与首次出场标注的数据集；开发结合视频与对话的模型，同时引入随电影推进逐步构建角色库的渐进式框架。
ai_summary.result: 论文提供了角色命名评测数据与标注、视频-对话模型，并与专有多模态大模型进行比较；整体支持在线、类人的电影理解，即从影片自身推断角色身份。
ai_summary.novelty: 将角色身份推断形式化为在线角色命名任务，并利用电影叙事线索与渐进式角色库实现无需外部先验的姓名-人物对应。
ai_summary.relevance: 对多模态视频理解、长视频叙事理解与具身/智能体式在线感知具有推动作用，强调从连续观察中逐步建立实体身份。

papers.title: PerceptRL: Making Visual Perception Rewardable in MLLMs from Answers to Interactions
papers.abstract: Fine-grained visual perception remains a bottleneck during post-training of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), as perceptual errors can constrain gains from reasoning-focused optimization. Although image-caption pre-training improves perception, its influence can weaken as subsequent stages change data mixtures and objectives. Continuing caption supervision during post-training is challenging because subjective, information-dense descriptions complicate verifiable reward design. We present PerceptRL, which strengthens perception at two complementary levels. Perception RL uses a multi-agent pipeline to extract verified errors from dense image captions and convert the corresponding visual facts into QA pairs with fixed answer labels and rule-based rewards. Chain QA links correlated errors, while multiple-choice QA combines unrelated errors. A specialized route targets high-error domains with tailored verification, and a domain-agnostic general route covers errors beyond these domains. Perception Agentic RL addresses fine-grained and dense cases unresolved by single-turn Perception RL through multi-turn inspection with visual tools. We observe coordinate drift even in models trained to use tools, where incorrect crops or annotations distort evidence and propagate errors. Coordinate Injection corrects spatial operations in cold-start trajectories, while a grounding-aware process reward supervises intermediate spatial fidelity alongside final-answer correctness. Training proceeds through shared cold-start SFT, single-turn Perception RL, and multi-turn Perception Agentic RL. Across seven benchmarks under a shared tool-use protocol, PerceptRL achieves 71.6% average accuracy, surpassing the base model with the same tools and the strongest evaluated frontier VLM by 15.7 and 5.2 percentage points, respectively.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型后训练中细粒度视觉感知仍是瓶颈，caption预训练的感知收益会随训练阶段变化而减弱；但后训练中继续用caption监督又因描述主观、信息密集而难以设计可验证奖励。
ai_summary.method: 提出PerceptRL，从两个层面强化感知：Perception RL用多智能体流程从密集图像caption中抽取可验证错误并转成固定答案标签、规则奖励的QA对，结合Chain QA与多选题QA及专用/通用路由；Perception Agentic RL用多轮视觉工具检查处理单轮难解决的细粒度密集案例，并用Coordinate Injection纠正冷启动轨迹中的坐标漂移、用grounding-aware过程奖励监督中间空间保真度。训练依次经过共享冷启动SFT、单轮Perception RL和多轮Perception Agentic RL。
ai_summary.result: 在共享工具使用协议下的7个基准上，PerceptRL平均准确率达71.6%，分别超过使用相同工具的基座模型15.7个百分点、超过最强评测前沿VLM 5.2个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是把密集caption中的感知错误转化为可验证QA奖励，并结合多轮工具交互、坐标注入和空间grounding过程奖励来强化MLLM的细粒度视觉感知。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作提升了多模态大模型感知后训练的可验证性与工具使用可靠性，对多模态Agent和具身智能中的细粒度视觉理解具有参考价值。

papers.title: Representing the Unseen: Rethinking Visual Imagination for Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract: Visual world models increasingly support spatial reasoning by generating RGB views of unobserved states. However, RGB has become the default interface largely because it is well suited for visual generation, rather than necessarily being the most effective representation for downstream reasoning. Different spatial questions may benefit from different representations of the same imagined state: top-down geometry can facilitate global distance comparisons, while panoramic views provide broader context for reasoning about open space. To isolate the role of representation in spatial imagination, we introduce ImagiRep, a simulator-grounded benchmark of 922 questions spanning seven question types across two settings, Viewpoint Imagination and Cross-view Integration, providing oracle RGB and six alternative representations (e.g., depth, panoramic views, and top-down geometry) of the same unobserved state. This controlled comparison reveals that even accurate imagined RGB does not guarantee accurate spatial reasoning, and different questions benefit from different representations. Similar trends hold for representations derived from world-model-estimated states. Notably, estimated RGB alone can mislead spatial reasoning, while alternative representations retain complementary benefits. Building on these findings, we introduce GEARS, a lightweight test-time strategy for adaptive representation selection, outperforming existing spatial imagination methods and showing that reasoning about unseen states requires more than generating RGB views.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉世界模型通常以生成RGB视图作为空间推理接口，但RGB未必是下游空间推理最有效的表示；论文要回答不同想象状态表示如何影响空间推理，以及准确生成RGB是否足以保证推理正确。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出ImagiRep基准，基于模拟器构建922个问题，覆盖视点想象和跨视角整合两类设置、七种问题类型，并为同一未观测状态提供oracle RGB及深度、全景、俯视几何等六种替代表示进行受控比较；进一步提出轻量测试时自适应表示选择策略GEARS。
ai_summary.result: 实验发现即使想象出的RGB准确，也不一定能带来准确空间推理，不同问题受益于不同表示；世界模型估计状态上也呈现类似趋势，单独估计RGB可能误导推理，而替代表示保留互补优势。GEARS优于现有空间想象方法。
ai_summary.novelty: 系统隔离并评估“表示形式”在空间想象中的作用，指出RGB默认接口的局限，并提出自适应表示选择策略。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作提示世界模型和具身智能中的空间推理不应只追求生成RGB视图，而应根据任务选择更合适的中间表示。

papers.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
papers.abstract: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.

ai_summary.problem: 需要一种开放的多模态嵌入模型，能在统一空间中原生表示文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合，并在质量与效率上取得更好平衡。
ai_summary.method: 提出 EmbeddingGemma 2，采用简化的逐层嵌入和多阶段课程学习，让模态与训练目标逐步推进；同时支持选择性加载模态编码器、可调视觉 token 预算、可截断嵌入维度和量化权重。
ai_summary.result: 在覆盖所有模态的综合嵌入基准上建立新的帕累托前沿，优于专用模型以及大 2 到 12 倍的模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是统一且高效的多模态嵌入设计，并结合课程学习与资源受限场景下的灵活部署能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 对多模态检索、RAG、Agent 记忆与跨模态理解等应用具有重要价值，并推动开放多模态嵌入研究。

papers.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中泛化受限，主要受制于带动作标注的机器人演示数据多样性和覆盖不足；而从人类视频学习又面临可扩展数据与显式动作 grounding 之间的权衡。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ThinkWorld 框架，将每个动作思维表示为 Chain-of-Dynamics（CoD），即一串离散运动 token，刻画从当前世界到未来状态的中间动力学，并作为跨具身共享的动作表示。先用带动作标注的演示初始化 CoD，再预测每个 CoD 诱导的未来，并通过强化学习奖励那些预测更匹配真实观测结果的 CoD，从而让无动作标注视频也能通过状态转移提供监督。
ai_summary.result: 在仿真和真实机器人上的实验表明，该方法能有效实现人类到机器人的迁移，并对未见任务和环境表现出较强泛化能力。
ai_summary.novelty: 将动作推理 grounding 到世界动力学中，并用世界想象驱动的强化学习从未标注视频的状态转移中学习统一的跨具身动作表示。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLA 和具身智能提供了一条利用大规模人类视频提升数据效率、跨具身迁移和泛化能力的新路径，也与世界模型驱动的动作推理密切相关。

papers.title: VideoLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning over Grounded Video Evidence
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning has substantially advanced video understanding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, language-based reasoning traces do not provide a reliable mechanism for models to revisit relevant visual evidence, leading to visual forgetting and impairing their ability to reason over video content. Existing approaches maintain visual grounding during reasoning in two main ways: they either refer to evidence using textual coordinates, which specify symbolic locations rather than the visual content itself, or reinsert cropped regions or frames into the multimodal context, preserving visual details at the cost of substantial context expansion. To address these limitations, we introduce VideoLVR, which constructs latent visual evidence from local regions at relevant video moments, thereby providing visual support for intermediate reasoning steps. To supervise latent visual evidence generation, we introduce a visual token prediction objective that formulates visual token reconstruction as prediction over a vocabulary derived from the input video, thereby unifying visual evidence reconstruction and text generation within the same token prediction framework. This shared prediction framework enables MLLMs to reason over interleaved text tokens and latent visual states while integrating evidence from different moments. We further extend VideoLVR to reinforcement learning by treating sampled visual tokens as actions alongside text tokens and jointly optimizing the policy using final-answer rewards. By efficiently revisiting task-relevant visual information during reasoning, VideoLVR improves video understanding without substantially expanding the multimodal context. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness, especially on tasks requiring fine-grained visual evidence.

ai_summary.problem: 现有多模态大模型在视频思维链推理中，基于语言的推理轨迹无法可靠地回看视觉证据，导致视觉遗忘，难以进行细粒度视频推理。
ai_summary.method: 提出 VideoLVR，在推理过程中从相关视频时刻的局部区域构建潜在视觉证据（latent visual evidence）作为中间推理步骤的视觉支撑；设计基于输入视频词表的视觉 token 预测目标，将视觉证据重建与文本生成统一到同一 token 预测框架；并扩展到强化学习，将采样得到的视觉 token 视为与文本 token 并列的动作，用最终答案奖励联合优化策略。
ai_summary.result: 模型可在推理中交错生成文本与潜在视觉状态并整合不同时刻的证据，在不显著扩张多模态上下文的前提下提升视频理解效果，在需要细粒度视觉证据的任务上尤为明显。
ai_summary.novelty: 用从输入视频词表重建的潜在视觉 token 替代文本坐标或裁剪帧回插，实现统一 token 预测框架下的视觉证据重建与推理，并可与强化学习联合优化。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视频多模态大模型的“视觉接地推理”提供了低上下文开销的新范式，有望缓解视觉遗忘并推动细粒度视频推理与世界模型式证据追踪。
ai_summary.org: 未能识别（作者机构信息缺失）

papers.title: Zero-Shot Multimodal Event Spotting in Soccer Broadcasts
papers.abstract: Automatic soccer event spotting supports highlight generation, video indexing, and sports analytics, but existing methods depend on large annotated datasets and soccer-specific training. We present a zero-shot framework that detects, classifies, and temporally localizes events in full-length soccer broadcasts without task-specific parameter training. Each match is segmented into overlapping clips represented by a compact visual storyboard and the aligned commentary transcript, which a general-purpose multimodal model processes jointly. On three manually annotated matches containing 130 events, the best configuration achieves 72.0% F1@5s and outperforms SoccerNet-trained CALF and NetVLAD++ in a cross-dataset setting, while the storyboard representation reduces inference cost by 72% compared with individual frames. We further analyze the effects of model family, input representation, and prompt optimization, and introduce an evidence-grounded excitement-scoring stage that ranks detected events with natural-language explanations for highlight selection.

ai_summary.problem: 足球转播中的事件检测通常依赖大规模标注数据和足球领域专用训练，本文旨在无需任务特定参数训练的情况下，实现全长足球转播中的事件零样本检测、分类与时间定位。
ai_summary.method: 将每场比赛切分为重叠片段，用紧凑的视觉故事板和对齐的解说文本表示片段，再交由通用多模态模型联合处理；同时引入基于证据的兴奋度评分阶段，用自然语言解释对检测到的事件排序以辅助集锦选择。
ai_summary.result: 在三场人工标注、共130个事件的比赛上，最佳配置达到72.0% F1@5s，并在跨数据集设置下优于经SoccerNet训练的CALF和NetVLAD++；故事板表示相比逐帧输入降低72%推理成本。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出无需领域训练的零样本多模态足球事件检测框架，结合视觉故事板与解说文本，并用证据支撑的兴奋度评分和自然语言解释进行集锦排序。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明通用多模态大模型可在不依赖大规模领域标注的情况下完成体育视频事件检测与定位，为低标注成本的多模态视频理解提供了新思路。
ai_summary.org: 未知

papers.title: Gym-Anything-RT: Scaling Real-Time Environments for Vision-Language Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents have made substantial progress in domains where they have a non-trivial amount of time to deliberate between actions, such as mathematics, software engineering, and performing tasks on desktop applications. It is less clear how such models fare in settings that demand real-time interaction, such as playing a video game or operating a physical device. In these settings, the environment state may evolve as the agent is reasoning, or even as the underlying model is performing a forward pass. To gain insight into the real-time interaction capabilities of vision-language agents, we introduce Gym-Anything-RT. Our key idea is to construct visual minigames that demand a portfolio of capabilities required for interactive real-time settings. Gym-Anything-RT uses an agentic pipeline to automatically generate such environments based on a taxonomy of six capabilities required for real-time interaction, including the ability to perceive the environment and act under an evolving environment state. A key feature of Gym-Anything-RT is that it allows for controlled comparison of real-time interaction capabilities: we can run the same minigame in real time, or pause or slow down the environment to relax the requirement for real-time actions. We use Gym-Anything-RT to construct 100 real-time minigames and evaluate AI agents on them. We find large capability gaps in real-time interaction. For example, GPT-6 Astra (xHigh) achieves a pass rate of only 9.0% on the real-time minigames, which rises to 75.0% when the environment is paused. We also identify intriguing behaviors by the most powerful frontier agents: for instance, when given the ability to write code, these agents write code that bypasses the need to perceive and act in real time. We publicly release Gym-Anything-RT and the generated minigames to spur further research on AI agents in real-time interactive settings.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉语言智能体在可充分思考的任务（数学、软件工程、桌面操作）上进展显著，但在需要实时交互的场景（玩游戏、操作物理设备）中能力如何尚不清楚——这类环境中环境状态会在推理甚至前向传播过程中持续演化。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出 Gym-Anything-RT，基于实时交互所需的六类能力分类体系，用智能体流水线自动生成视觉小游戏作为实时交互环境；其关键设计是同一小游戏既可在实时条件下运行，也可暂停或放慢环境，从而对同一能力做受控对比，分离出“实时性”这一变量。
ai_summary.result: 构建了 100 个实时小游戏并评测多个智能体，发现实时交互能力存在巨大缺口：GPT-6 Astra (xHigh) 实时通过率仅 9.0%，而环境暂停后升至 75.0%；此外最强的前沿智能体会写出绕过实时感知与行动的代码。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过“同一环境可实时/可暂停”的可控对比设计，把实时交互能力从其他能力中剥离出来，并用自动化流水线规模化生成此类评测环境。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型与具身/交互式智能体提供了可扩展的实时性评测基准，凸显当前模型在动态环境下的根本短板，并提示“写代码绕过”等奖励投机行为。
ai_summary.org: 卡内基梅隆大学（CMU）（据作者推断，原文未给出机构信息）

papers.title: Which Hand Was Late? Diagnosis for Robot Failure Recovery in Bimanual Tool Use
papers.abstract: Failure diagnosers for robot manipulation are increasingly vision--language models (VLMs), trained and evaluated on single-arm failures produced by perturbing a successful demonstration. Bimanual tool use adds failures of other kinds: a tool that slips out of its socket while still held, two correct gestures made at different times, and attempts that fail for two reasons at once. On a simulated bimanual tool-use task whose failure causes are read from the recorded trace, we measure what each sensing channel lets a diagnoser tell. The tool's slip is read on the tool hand; which hand was late is read on both arms, while a sensor on one hand reads its own hand's delay and at most part of the other's; and whether a late attempt was also pushed too weakly is not identifiable from passive sensing when the tool hand is late. Within two attempts, a repair policy that escalates when the cause is not identifiable repairs as many failures as one told the true cause. A VLM's internal state carries the late hand almost perfectly, along a direction no closer to the one its answer reads than a random one; whether the answer reports it depends on the wording of the question.

ai_summary.problem: 现有机器人操作故障诊断器多基于单臂扰动失败训练与评估，难以覆盖双机械臂工具使用中工具滑脱、双手时序错误及多重原因并发等故障；论文要厘清不同传感通道能诊断哪些故障，并支持恢复。
ai_summary.method: 在可记录故障原因的双臂工具使用仿真任务中，分析各传感通道对各类故障的可识别性；评估在原因不可识别时升级处理的修复策略；并探测VLM内部状态是否编码“哪只手晚了”以及其答案是否受提问措辞影响。
ai_summary.result: 工具滑脱可由工具手读出，“哪只手晚”需双臂信息，单手感测最多读到自身延迟和另一手部分延迟；当工具手晚时，被动传感无法同时识别“晚且推得太弱”。原因不可识别时升级的修复策略可在两次尝试内达到告知真实原因的效果；VLM内部状态几乎完美编码晚手信息，但答案是否报告取决于问题措辞。
ai_summary.novelty: 从传感可识别性与VLM内部状态—输出不一致的角度系统诊断双臂工具使用故障，并给出支持恢复的实用策略。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人故障诊断、VLM作为诊断器的可靠性及双臂具身智能恢复策略提供了重要分析框架。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未在提供信息中给出

papers.title: World Dreamer v5-lite: A Multi-Robot World Action Model with One Dreamer
papers.abstract: Multi-robot control requires integrating distributed camera views while predicting separate action sequences. Most vision-language-action and world-action models target one robot. Combining multiple views alone does not establish spatial correspondence between them. World Dreamer v5-lite is a multi-robot world-action model built around a shared world state for robot-specific action prediction. Calibrated features from a pretrained video encoder populate this state in workspace coordinates; its spatial size remains fixed as views are added. A vision-language model provides scene context and one query per robot. The queries read the shared state and exchange pose-aware information, while their action streams remain separate. Masked-view cooperative training withholds selected camera views from both visual branches while retaining all action targets. This encourages the use of observations shared by other robots. Pretraining uses more than 10,000 hours of trajectories from 20 simulated robot types, RoboFactory, and real robots. On RoboFactory, World Dreamer v5-lite achieves 74.0% mean success, 23.7 percentage points above the strongest evaluated baseline. Across four real-robot tasks, it reaches 78.8% mean success, a margin of 13.8 points. It also reaches 58.08% overall on RoboCasa365.

ai_summary.problem: 多机器人控制需要融合多个分布式的相机视角，并为每个机器人分别预测动作序列，而现有视觉-语言-动作模型与世界动作模型大多只针对单个机器人；并且简单地把多个视角拼接起来，并不能建立它们之间的空间对应关系。
ai_summary.method: 提出 World Dreamer v5-lite，这是一个以共享世界状态为核心的多机器人世界动作模型：它用预训练视频编码器提供的已校准特征，在工作空间坐标系下填充一个空间尺寸固定的共享世界状态；视觉语言模型提供场景上下文，并为每个机器人提供一个查询，这些查询读取共享状态并交换带有位姿信息，但各自的动作流保持分离。训练时采用掩码视角协同训练，即对两个视觉分支都屏蔽部分相机视角，同时保留全部动作目标。
ai_summary.result: 在 RoboFactory 上取得74.0%的平均成功率，比最强的评测基线高23.7个百分点；在四个真实机器人任务上平均成功率为78.8%，高出13.8个百分点；在 RoboCasa365 上总体达到58.08%。
ai_summary.novelty: 用工作空间坐标系下的固定空间尺寸共享世界状态，来统一多视角空间对应与按机器人区分的动作预测，并配合掩码视角协同训练，促进跨机器人观测共享。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多机器人、多视角场景下的世界模型与动作预测提供了可扩展的统一建模范式，推动世界动作模型从单机器人走向多机器人协同。
ai_summary.org: World Agents

papers.title: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
papers.abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns through direct prediction of future RGB, depth, and optical-flow features, with auxiliary supervision through a frozen pretrained video world model. Training relies entirely on publicly available data, expanded through human-to-robot synthesis, subtask annotation, and embodied chain-of-thought (ECoT) annotation. Across four simulation benchmarks, PDRVLA achieves success rates of 99.3% on LIBERO, 89.9% on LIBERO-Plus, 93.6% on RoboTwin~2.0, and 81.5% on SimplerEnv. Ablations show improved future prediction with world-model supervision and evaluate how subtask conditioning, future object-pose supervision, and ECoT training affect action success.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型对物理动态的理解有限，而依赖视频世界模型在线生成未来视频又会给控制回路带来高延迟。论文希望在避免在线视频生成的前提下，增强VLA模型对物理动态的建模能力。
ai_summary.method: 提出PDRVLA，其中轻量级Physical Dynamics Module从视觉-语言特征中提取物理token，用于条件化动作生成。该模块通过直接预测未来RGB、深度和光流特征学习，并利用冻结的预训练视频世界模型提供辅助监督。训练完全基于公开数据，并通过人到机器人合成、子任务标注和具身思维链（ECoT）标注进行扩展。
ai_summary.result: 在四个仿真基准上取得较高成功率：LIBERO 99.3%、LIBERO-Plus 89.9%、RoboTwin 2.0 93.6%、SimplerEnv 81.5%。消融实验表明世界模型监督能改善未来预测，并评估了子任务条件、未来物体位姿监督和ECoT训练对动作成功的影响。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用轻量级物理动态模块提取物理token来条件化动作生成，并借助冻结视频世界模型做辅助监督，从而避免在线视频生成的高延迟。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为VLA模型引入物理动态表征提供了高效路径，有助于提升机器人操作策略对场景演化的理解与泛化能力。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未在提供信息中列出，无法识别

papers.title: VLA-Stem: A Lightweight Safety Mechanism for Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate high-level reasoning with low-level action execution for end-to-end robotic control. However, most VLA models target static manipulation in unconstrained environments, overlooking spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. Fine-tuning VLAs on obstacle-avoidance data is a straightforward solution, but collecting such data is costly, especially for dynamic scenarios, and may degrade their original task capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose VLA-Stem, a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism for VLA systems. Without fine-tuning the underlying VLA policy, VLA-Stem converts its action chunks into motion references and uses trajectory-level guidance to preserve their spatial intent while allowing flexible motion and timing adjustments. Conditioned on these references, robot proprioception, and local obstacle information, the Stem policy adaptively modifies execution at inference time, preserving the original task intent while enabling responsive adaptation to spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. For robust and sample-efficient training, we combine teacher-student distillation with curriculum learning. We evaluate VLA-Stem on reference following, static spatial constraints, and dynamic obstacle avoidance. Across six constrained simulation settings, VLA-Stem achieves 52.8% average collision-free task success versus 23.7% for the strongest safety baseline, while preserving base-policy performance in obstacle-free settings; real-world experiments further show consistent collision reductions under static and dynamic obstacles. These results demonstrate that VLA-Stem couples high-level VLA task intent with rapid, reflex-like responses to immediate physical risks, providing a brainstem-inspired mechanism for robust robot execution.

ai_summary.problem: 现有VLA模型多面向无约束静态操作，忽略空间约束与动态障碍；直接微调避障数据成本高且可能损害原有任务能力。
ai_summary.method: 提出VLA-Stem，一种轻量级强化学习安全机制，不微调底层VLA策略，而将其动作块转换为运动参考，并由Stem策略结合本体感知与局部障碍信息在推理时自适应调整轨迹和时序。训练上结合教师-学生蒸馏与课程学习。
ai_summary.result: 在六种受限仿真设置中，VLA-Stem平均无碰撞任务成功率达52.8%，显著高于最强安全基线的23.7%，并在无障碍场景保持基础策略性能；真实实验也显示静态和动态障碍下碰撞减少。
ai_summary.novelty: 以“脑干式”轻量安全层在推理时衔接高层VLA任务意图与快速反射式避障，无需微调原VLA策略。
ai_summary.relevance: 为VLA和具身智能系统提供了一种可插拔、低成本的实时安全增强范式，有助于推动机器人在真实约束环境中的可靠部署。
ai_summary.org: 摘要中未提供作者机构信息

papers.title: Generalizable Target-Less Joint Intrinsic-Extrinsic Camera-LiDAR Calibration using Deep Pixel-Point Correspondences
papers.abstract: Accurate camera-LiDAR calibration is an essential prerequisite for robust multi-modal perception in robotics. Recent target-less methods based on learned pixel-point correspondences achieve high extrinsic calibration accuracy and generalize across environments. However, they operate on rectified images with known camera intrinsics, restricting their applicability to systems whose cameras have already been individually calibrated. We present a fully automatic, target-less framework that jointly estimates camera intrinsics, radial-tangential distortion, and camera-LiDAR extrinsics from raw images and LiDAR scans. Our method generalizes deep correspondence-based calibration from rectified images to raw cameras through intrinsic- and distortion-aware correspondence learning via synthetic augmentations. During calibration, we iteratively couple correspondence prediction and nonlinear optimization to jointly refine the camera parameters and relative sensor transformation. We evaluate our approach on an unseen camera-LiDAR configuration from the KITTI dataset and on three real robotic platforms in a zero-shot manner. The results demonstrate that joint calibration with our generalized pixel-point correspondence network improves extrinsic accuracy over correspondence-based methods using pre-calibrated cameras, while additionally recovering accurate intrinsics.

ai_summary.problem: 现有基于深度像素-点对应的无靶标相机-LiDAR标定方法依赖已校正图像和已知相机内参，无法直接用于未单独标定的原始相机。论文旨在从原始图像和LiDAR扫描中全自动联合估计相机内参、径向-切向畸变以及相机-LiDAR外参。
ai_summary.method: 作者通过合成数据增强学习内参与畸变感知的像素-点对应，将基于对应的标定从校正图像推广到原始相机。标定过程中迭代耦合对应预测与非线性优化，联合精化相机参数和传感器相对变换。
ai_summary.result: 在KITTI未见配置和三个真实机器人平台上零样本评估，联合标定相比使用预标定相机的对应方法提高了外参精度，同时恢复了准确的内参。
ai_summary.novelty: 将深度对应驱动的无靶标相机-LiDAR标定从已知内参的校正图像推广到原始未标定相机，并实现内参、畸变与外参的联合优化。
ai_summary.relevance: 提升了多模态感知系统在真实机器人上的自动标定能力与部署鲁棒性，对机器人和具身智能中的相机-LiDAR融合有实用价值。
ai_summary.org: University of Freiburg

papers.title: When Visual Evidence Is Insufficient: How Instructions, Post-Training, and Internal Activations Shape Refusal in Multimodal Language Models
papers.abstract: For reliable deployment, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should recognize when an image provides insufficient evidence to answer a question and withhold unsupported answers. Yet refusal alone is not necessarily evidence of such recognition: models may refuse because of unrelated safety constraints or without identifying the missing evidence. We study how refusal on visually unanswerable questions is shaped by three sources of control: inference-time instructions, post-training, and internal activation interventions. Across three MLLMs on the MoHoBench benchmark, we systematically manipulate the meaning and placement of refusal instructions, compare supervised and preference-based post-training, and intervene on a refusal-related activation direction derived from naturally answered and refused examples. We find that refusal is highly sensitive to both the meaning and placement of instructions, with model-specific changes at the sample level that are obscured by aggregate refusal rates. Evidence-aware and general refusal instructions have stronger effects than an intentionally mismatched safety instruction. Post-training produces larger increases in refusal, but can also induce responses that combine refusal language with attempted answers. In contrast, activation intervention produces smaller yet transferable changes across prompt conditions, without evidence of indiscriminate refusal on tested visually answerable samples. These findings show that refusal is jointly shaped by external instructions, post-training, and internal representations, highlighting the need to disentangle evidence recognition from a model's learned propensity to refuse.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型在面对图像证据不足以回答问题时应学会拒答，但拒答本身未必代表模型真正识别到证据缺失，本文要厘清拒答行为究竟由哪些因素驱动。
ai_summary.method: 在 MoHoBench 基准上对三个多模态大模型系统操控三类因素：推理时的拒答指令（语义与位置）、监督式与偏好式后训练、以及由自然作答/拒答样例导出的拒答相关激活方向干预，并在样本级与总体拒答率两个层面分析行为变化。
ai_summary.result: 拒答对指令的语义和放置位置高度敏感，证据感知指令效果强于不匹配的安全指令；后训练能大幅提升拒答但会产生“既拒答又尝试作答”的混合响应；激活干预效果虽小却可跨提示条件迁移，且不会对可视觉回答的样本造成无差别拒答。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次在同一框架下系统对比外部指令、后训练与内部激活三类控制源对“视觉证据不足型拒答”的影响，并揭示总体拒答率掩盖的样本级差异。
ai_summary.relevance: 提示社区需将“证据识别能力”与“习得的拒答倾向”解耦评估，对多模态模型可靠性与安全对齐评测具有方法论意义。
ai_summary.org: 论文未标注机构；据作者（Vineeth N Balasubramanian 等）推断可能为印度理工学院海得拉巴分校（IIT Hyderabad）

papers.title: Beyond the Readout: A Latent Numerical Frame Shared Across Modality and Operation
papers.abstract: When a multimodal model computes 17+35 from text or 91-39 from a rendered image, it produces the same answer, 52. Does it use one internal concept of number for both, or separate machinery for each path? Similarity metrics such as RSA or CKA cannot settle this question. They give the same score to identical and to rotated directions, and two representations can look alike only because both prepare the same output digits. We therefore use causal interventions. For four conditions (text or image, addition or subtraction), we learn a small subspace of Gemma4-12B-it's residual stream in which swapping coordinates swaps the model's answer. The subspaces answer three questions. First, do the conditions write numbers along the same directions? They do not. Reusing a subspace from text in an image on the same operation recovers only 53.2% of its causal effect. A single rotation and rescaling maps one subspace onto the other and raises recovery to 91.4%, so the conditions share one geometry expressed in different coordinates. Second, does this shared geometry only reflect the digit the model is about to print? To test this, we split each subspace into 9 directions that the output layer reads to choose the next digit and 13 directions that it cannot see. The 13 hidden directions still carry the number, yet changing them barely alters the digit being written. Third, what are these hidden directions for? A model must emit a multi-digit answer one digit at a time, so it can compute the full result early and keep it in reserve. When two numbers share their first digit, swapping the number in the hidden directions leaves the digit being written intact and redirects the next digit in 77.6% of cases. The model thus forms an abstract numerical concept upstream and unfolds it across time: multimodal representations share meaning through relational geometry across distinct coordinate frames.

papers.title: JEPA-Inspired Latent Field Prediction for Sparse-Pilot MIMO-OFDM Channel Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Accurate acquisition of full channel state information (CSI) is essential for multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) wireless systems, while dense pilot-based estimation incurs substantial overhead. Directly minimizing the prediction error over raw CSI coefficients is fragile in realistic propagation environments, since small-scale fading, mobility, local scattering, and small spatial perturbations can induce large phase-sensitive variations. Nevertheless, wireless channels contain strong spatial, temporal, and frequency-domain correlations that can be more predictably represented in a latent propagation-field domain. Motivated by this observation, we propose a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA)-inspired field world model, defined as a latent predictive model of the wireless propagation field, for sparse-pilot channel reconstruction. The model maps CSI observations into latent time-frequency tokens, predicts masked or future latent field states from historical multi-band context, and fuses the predicted latent prior with sparse noisy current pilots to reconstruct the full MIMO-OFDM channel. Ray-tracing experiments show that the proposed method improves normalized mean square error (NMSE) over pilot-only and direct reconstruction baselines, supporting latent field prediction as an effective prior for sparse-pilot channel acquisition.

ai_summary.problem: 在 MIMO-OFDM 系统中，密集导频带来巨大开销，而仅用稀疏导频直接对原始 CSI 系数做预测又容易受到小尺度衰落、移动性、局部散射等引起的相位敏感变化影响，重建脆弱。论文要解决稀疏导频下的全信道重建问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出一种受 JEPA 启发的“场世界模型”，将 CSI 观测映射为潜在时频 token，从历史多频段上下文中预测被掩蔽或未来的潜在传播场状态，再把预测的潜在先验与当前稀疏含噪导频融合，重建完整的 MIMO-OFDM 信道。关键是在潜在传播场域而非原始 CSI 系数上做预测。
ai_summary.result: 射线追踪实验表明，该方法在 NMSE 上优于仅用导频和直接重建的基线，说明潜在场预测可作为稀疏导频信道获取的有效先验。
ai_summary.novelty: 把 JEPA 式的潜在空间预测/世界模型思想迁移到无线传播场的信道重建中，用潜在场预测替代对原始 CSI 的直接回归。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型与自监督潜在预测方法在无线物理层等非视觉领域的跨域应用提供了实证案例。

papers.title: TimeLineXR: An Interactive Exploration of Time in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Recently, it has been shown that vision-language models (VLMs) have a certain intrinsic understanding of time. They can estimate the temporal origin of objects and encode time along a low-dimensional, non-linear manifold inside their embedding space~\cite{tekaya2025matter}. That result is quantitative and reproducible, but the structure itself stays out of reach for end users: they cannot see it, query it with their own images, or inspect where a query lands relative to other years on the time axis. We present TimeLineXR, an interactive demonstration that turns this time axis into an explorable 3D scene. A web demo lets users upload or select images and see each placed on a color-coded 3D time axis; a Three.js WebXR scene renders the same time axis as a room-scale representation that can be grabbed, scaled, inspected, and queried by throwing image cards into it. Both clients run the same prediction pipeline against the same cached temporal index: encode the query with CLIP, project it through cosine-kernel KPCA, and snap it to the Bézier time axis. The system turns each image into a point on the time axis, so users can compare where different objects land and read off their estimated first year of appearance.Code source and reproduction steps can be found in: https://github.com/sterngefeuert/timeline-xr.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的嵌入空间中已发现存在可量化、可复现的时间轴结构，但这一结构对终端用户完全不可见——用户无法用自己的图像查询它，也无法观察某张图像在时间轴上落在哪一年附近。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了 TimeLineXR 交互式演示系统：用户上传或选择图像后，先用 CLIP 编码，再通过余弦核 KPCA 投影，最后对齐（snap）到贝塞尔时间轴上，得到该图像的估计年份。系统提供两个客户端——网页版二维/三维彩色时间轴，以及基于 Three.js 的 WebXR 房间级场景，用户可抓取、缩放、检视时间轴，并通过向其中投掷图像卡片来进行查询；两者共享同一预测流程与缓存的时间索引。
ai_summary.result: 每张图像都被映射为时间轴上的一个点，用户可直观比较不同物体（如椅子、电话等）在时间轴上的落点，并读取模型估计的该物体最早出现年份；系统已开源并提供复现步骤。
ai_summary.novelty: 创新点在于把 VLM 嵌入空间中抽象的“时间流形”转化为可交互、可查询的三维/XR 可视化场景，让非专业用户也能直接探索和检验模型内在的时间知识。
ai_summary.relevance: 为可解释性与模型探查提供了新的交互范式，把 VLM 内部表征研究从离线定量分析推进到可被用户直接操作与验证的沉浸式界面。
ai_summary.org: 所给信息中作者机构为空，无法确认；从作者名单看，可能隶属奥地利圣帕尔滕应用科技大学（St. Pölten UAS），但需核实。

key_lab_papers.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
key_lab_papers.abstract: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. Our approach introduces improvements such as simplified per-layer embeddings and a multi-stage curriculum with modality and objective progression which ensure strong quality across unimodal, cross-modal, and mixed-modal evaluations. Notably, in comprehensive embedding benchmarks across all modalities, EmbeddingGemma 2 establishes a new Pareto frontier, outperforming both specialist models and models two to twelve times larger. Furthermore, our design offers flexibility for resource-constrained environments, supporting selective modality encoder loading, adjustable vision token budgets, truncatable embedding dimensions, and quantized weights. We present ablations analyzing key decisions and release EmbeddingGemma 2 to promote further research.

ai_summary.problem: 需要一种开放的多模态嵌入模型，能在统一空间中原生表示文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合，并在质量与效率上取得更好平衡。
ai_summary.method: 提出 EmbeddingGemma 2，采用简化的逐层嵌入和多阶段课程学习，让模态与训练目标逐步推进；同时支持选择性加载模态编码器、可调视觉 token 预算、可截断嵌入维度和量化权重。
ai_summary.result: 在覆盖所有模态的综合嵌入基准上建立新的帕累托前沿，优于专用模型以及大 2 到 12 倍的模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是统一且高效的多模态嵌入设计，并结合课程学习与资源受限场景下的灵活部署能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 对多模态检索、RAG、Agent 记忆与跨模态理解等应用具有重要价值，并推动开放多模态嵌入研究。

key_lab_papers.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
key_lab_papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中泛化受限，主要受制于带动作标注的机器人演示数据多样性和覆盖不足；而从人类视频学习又面临可扩展数据与显式动作 grounding 之间的权衡。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ThinkWorld 框架，将每个动作思维表示为 Chain-of-Dynamics（CoD），即一串离散运动 token，刻画从当前世界到未来状态的中间动力学，并作为跨具身共享的动作表示。先用带动作标注的演示初始化 CoD，再预测每个 CoD 诱导的未来，并通过强化学习奖励那些预测更匹配真实观测结果的 CoD，从而让无动作标注视频也能通过状态转移提供监督。
ai_summary.result: 在仿真和真实机器人上的实验表明，该方法能有效实现人类到机器人的迁移，并对未见任务和环境表现出较强泛化能力。
ai_summary.novelty: 将动作推理 grounding 到世界动力学中，并用世界想象驱动的强化学习从未标注视频的状态转移中学习统一的跨具身动作表示。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLA 和具身智能提供了一条利用大规模人类视频提升数据效率、跨具身迁移和泛化能力的新路径，也与世界模型驱动的动作推理密切相关。
